title: The Lebrun--Salamon conjecture is true in dimension up to 56
summary: We prove the LeBrun--Salamon conjecture for positive quaternionic Kähler manifolds of quaternionic dimension n <= 14. To do so, we first show that the isometry group Isom(M) of any minimal counterexample M has rank at most one, hence dimension at most three. On the other hand, we consider a characteristic number which equals dim Isom(M) - (n+3) if n is even and dim Isom(M) - (n+1) if n is odd, and show that this index is a sum of positive quantities when n <= 14, yielding a contradiction.
